full_judgment:
Obaidul Hassan J. This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal has arisen out of the judgment and order dated 18.03.2021 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.7322 of 2021 making the Rule absolute. 

 2. The accused-respondent filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.7322 of 2021 before the High Court Division. The prosecution case, in short, is that one Md. Iqbal Hossain, BP- 8714166229, Senior Assistant Police Super, Organized Crime (Economic Crime Squad), CID, Bangladesh Police, Dhaka, as an informant lodged a First Information Report (hereinafter referred to as the FIR) with Uttara Paschim Police Station on 12.01.2019 at 20:45 hours regarding an alleged occurrence which took place in between 15.12.20.18 to 12.01.2019. On getting direction from the higher authority, the Senior Police Super, Organized. Crime (Economic Crime Squad), CID, Bangladesh Police, Dhaka formed a joint team with the officers. During investigation into the matter, at one stage one Surjamoni, son of Mohammad Satter Ali was interrogated. On interrogation he disclosed the name of accused Choice Rahman. Thereafter, the informant along with forces raided different places and recovered various alamats and prepared 3(three) separate seizure lists and also arrested accused Choice Rahman under section 54 of the Penal Code, 1860 and in this regard made a G.D. with Uttara Police Station and produced him before the Court of learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka on 07.01.2019. Thereafter, the-accused Choice Rahman was taken into remand for 1(one) day and after remand he disclosed names of some accused-persons including Afsana Mim C Mim and he also said that there were some unknown persons involved with the crime. Hence, the case was lodged. 

 5. The case was sent to the learned Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka being numbered as Metropolitan Sessions Case No.19558 of 2020, who after hearing the parties, considering the materials on record fixed the next date for hearing of charge matter on 30.05.2021. 

 7. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the order of rejection of prayer for bail in G.R. No.9 of 2019 arising out of Uttara Paschim Police Station Case No.9 dated 12.01.2019 under section 36(1) of the Table 7(Ga), 8(Ga) of Serial No.17 and sections 40 and 41 of the Madak Drabba Niyatran Ain, 2018, the accused-respondent filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.7322 'of 2021 before the High Court Division and after hearing, the High Court Division made the Rule absolute by its judgment and order dated 18.03.2021 and enlarged the respondent on bail. 

 9. Mr. Biswajit Debnath, Deputy Attorney General, appearing for the petitioner, has taken us through the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division, the relevant provisions of law, the connected materials on record and submits that the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division making the Rule absolute clearly shows non-application of judicial mind having failed to appreciate that the accused-respondent is named in the FIR having strong prima-facie and specific overt act of committing heinous offence under section 36(1) of Table 7 (Ga), 8(Ga) of Serial No. 17 and sections 40 and 41 of the Madok Drabbya Niyantron Ain, 2018 from whose exclusive control and possession 302.359 kgs of heroin and 5.298 kgs of cocaine were recovered. He further submits that it is a very heinous offence and such kind of illegal businessmen is destroying the moral characters and future life of our young generation, without considering this aspect the High Court Division granted bail to the accused-respondent. He also submits that the case is under trial, at this stage the interim order of bail will totally frustrate the purpose of prosecution case creating obstacle on the way of free/fair trial. 

 11. We have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of both the parties, the relevant provisions of law and the connected materials on record. From the materials on record, it appears that the name of the accused respondent has been mentioned in the FIR and from her exclusive control and possession 302.359 kgs heroin and 5.298 kgs cocain were recovered. From the charge sheet submitted by the Investigating Officer, it appears that the accused respondent is the FIR named accused in many cases under Madak Drabba Niyatran Ain. For the offence the accused respondent is charged with, is an offence against the society and destroys the moral character and life of young generation. From the matters discussed above, we are of the view that there is strong prima facie case against the accused respondent. In this circumstance, if the accused respondent is enlarged on bail, then he would be harmful for the society.
